title: Eleusinian mysteries and earlier Minoan and Mycenaean forms

tellings.quote: Brian mirescu who wrote you know the immortality key he talks about the linian mystery rituals much later obviously in Greece

plain: The idea is that the Eleusinian mysteries, secret initiation rites of ancient Greece, carried on rituals much older than themselves, going back to the Minoan and Mycenaean cultures of Bronze Age Greece. Michels brings this up himself in an episode about a lost age around 12,000 BC. He points to the writer Brian Muraresku and his book The Immortality Key, which discusses the rites, and notes they come 'much later obviously' than the older forms.
